group.passage: Every parent hopes to watch a child grow up healthy and strong, but in many parts of the world this simple hope has not always come true. To see how well a country protects its youngest people, health experts often use one number called the child death rate. It shows how many children out of every 1,000 born alive die before they reach the age of five. The chart below gives this rate for the whole world and for two large regions in the years between 1990 and 2020. The world as a whole has made real progress during this period. In 1990, the rate was 93.5, but by 2020 it had dropped to 39.2. In other words, the chance of losing a young child fell by more than half in only thirty years. Behind each number are real families who no longer have to say goodbye to a son or a daughter too early. However, the progress has not been the same in every part of the world. South Asia moved the fastest of the three. Its rate started at 128.6, the second highest in 1990, but it fell all the way to 32.4 in 2020, which was even lower than the world rate. Sub-Saharan Africa also improved a great deal, from 178.5 to 75.9. Even so, its rate in 2020 was still about twice the world rate, so young children there still face much greater danger. In 2015, the United Nations agreed on a list of goals for a better and fairer world. One of these goals asks every country to lower the rate to 25 or below by the year 2030. For some places, this target is already within reach. For others, it will take many more years of hard work. Together, the numbers in the chart show both how far the world has come and how far it still has to go.

figures.caption: Children who die before age 5 (per 1,000 live births), 1990–2020
figures.description: 折線圖。橫軸是年份（1990、2000、2010、2020），縱軸是每 1,000 名活產嬰兒中五歲前死亡的人數。三條線都一路下降：World 從 93.5 降到 39.2；South Asia 從 128.6 降到 32.4，2020 年低於 World；Sub-Saharan Africa 從 178.5 降到 75.9，每一年都是三條線中最高的。

chart.title: Children who die before age 5, 1990–2020
chart.note: Each line shows the rate for the region as a whole.

source.title: World Development Indicators: Mortality rate, under-5 (per 1,000 live births)

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?

options.A: Why parents in poor countries worry about their children.
options.B: How the death rate of young children has changed since 1990.
options.C: How the United Nations trains health workers around the world.
options.D: Which region has the best hospitals for young children.

questions.stem: According to the chart, which group had the highest rate in 2020?

options.D: All three groups had about the same rate.

questions.stem: Which of the following is true about South Asia?

options.A: Its rate in 2020 was lower than the world rate.
options.B: Its rate went up between 2010 and 2020.
options.C: It has already reached the goal for 2030.
options.D: Its rate in 1990 was the highest in the chart.

questions.stem: In the last paragraph, what does “within reach” mean?

1.explanation_zh: 第一段說明「兒童死亡率」這個數字並介紹圖表，第二到第四段依序談全球的下降、各區域的差異與 2030 年的目標，主旨是 1990 年以來五歲以下兒童死亡率的變化。
evidence: The chart below gives this rate for the whole world and for two large regions in the years between 1990 and 2020.
Together, the numbers in the chart show both how far the world has come and how far it still has to go.

option_notes_zh.A: 第一段只用父母的期望開頭，沒有談父母為什麼擔心。
option_notes_zh.C: 文中沒有提到聯合國訓練醫護人員。

1.strategy_zh: 主旨題看首段的介紹句和末段的總結句。
hints: 先看第一段最後一句介紹了什麼。
再看最後一段最後一句。

2.explanation_zh: 圖中 2020 年 Sub-Saharan Africa 是 75.9，高於 World 的 39.2 和 South Asia 的 32.4。
evidence: Sub-Saharan Africa also improved a great deal, from 178.5 to 75.9.

option_notes_zh.A: World 2020 年是 39.2，比 Sub-Saharan Africa 低。
option_notes_zh.B: South Asia 2020 年是 32.4，三者最低。
option_notes_zh.D: 75.9 大約是 39.2 的兩倍，差很多。

3.explanation_zh: 第三段說 South Asia 2020 年降到 32.4，比全球的比率還低。
evidence: Its rate started at 128.6, the second highest in 1990, but it fell all the way to 32.4 in 2020, which was even lower than the world rate.

option_notes_zh.C: 目標是 25 以下，32.4 還沒達到。
option_notes_zh.D: 1990 年最高的是 Sub-Saharan Africa 的 178.5。

4.explanation_zh: 下一句用 For others 對比「還要努力很多年」，所以 within reach 是「很快就能達到」。
evidence: For some places, this target is already within reach.
For others, it will take many more years of hard work.

open_tasks.prompt: Write one English sentence that tells the main idea of the passage.
reference_answers: Since 1990, fewer young children have died before age five, but some regions still have a long way to go.
The child death rate has fallen a lot since 1990, though progress has been uneven across regions.
